name: regional-insurer
description: Mid-size general insurer, run through the month-end close engine

cfo.voice: measured, technical about reserves, allergic to surprise

episode_text.event.pipeline_failed: The claims reserving pipeline failed. Open claims could not be valued for the period.
episode_text.event.hypothesis_recorded: Initial triage attributed the failure to an overnight ledger platform outage.
episode_text.event.hypothesis_superseded: The ledger platform outage hypothesis was ruled out; platform logs showed no interruption in the window.
episode_text.event.root_cause_confirmed: Root cause confirmed as a stale legacy-to-new peril-code mapping, leaving {affected:,} open claims unmapped and unvaluable.
episode_text.fact.hypothesis_ruled_out: Ledger platform logs show no interruption during the reserving window
episode_text.fact.cause: Stale legacy-to-new peril-code mapping in the Policy and Claims Register
episode_text.fact.classification: control_failure: the peril-code mapping has no registered owner and no required reviewer

lore.assertion: Claims data was migrated to a new platform and the legacy peril-code mapping has been maintained by hand ever since.

constrains.effect: A hand-maintained mapping drifts, so valuation-style failures recur
Legacy and new peril codes are both in use and not interchangeable

lore.assertion: Month-end close is expected to finish within four business days; overruns page the Group CFO the same day.

constrains.effect: Status reporting swells during the close
Close cycle time is a standing CFO metric

lore.assertion: Personal Lines attributes its margin pressure to pricing decisions taken jointly with Commercial; Commercial regards those campaigns as Personal Lines' own choice.

constrains.effect: Margin commentary attributes cause outside the unit
Campaign depth is reported separately by unit
